title: On Engaging a new nurse before Easter
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：engage　|　正文 355 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 engage 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the nurse ① engaged a new nurse before Easter for the whole place, and every sufferer in the ward said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the nurse ② engages a new nurse before Easter without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ engage a new nurse before Easter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ engaged a new nurse before Easter before — a line in the report for April 1961 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Engaging a new nurse before Easter for the whole place, the nurse said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ engage everybody in the search without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Engage everybody in the search at once and never mention it again.

By 1974 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new sufferer from the next ward ⑧ engages everybody in the search for the whole place every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cupboard, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ engaged a new nurse before Easter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To engage a new nurse before Easter, my mother said in 1979, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the ward remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the ward forgets, somebody engages a new nurse before Easter without a word of thanks again and somebody must engage a new nurse before Easter for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 聘用（一般过去式 engaged a new nurse before Easter：1967 年护士头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 聘用（一般现在 engages a new nurse before Easter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 聘用（不定式 to engage a new nurse before Easter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 聘用（过去完成时 had engaged a new nurse before Easter：1961 年四月的护理记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 聘用（动名词 engaging a new nurse before Easter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使参加（engage everybody in the search：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使参加让所有人都参加了搜寻）
G. v. 使参加（engage everybody in the search：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 聘用（后段两处：新来的病患照例 engages everybody in the search，而母亲又一次 engaged a new nurse before Easter）

answers.why: engage 意为“聘用”，1967 年护士替所有人聘用复活节前聘了一位新看护，那是病房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 engaged。
engage 意为“聘用”，自那以后护士不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 engages。
engage 意为“聘用”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯聘用复活节前聘了一位新看护”，此处为不定式 to engage a new nurse before Easter。
engage 意为“聘用”，护理记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1974 年之前就有人聘用过，故用过去完成时 had engaged。
engage 意为“聘用”，护士说“聘用复活节前聘了一位新看护这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 engaging a new nurse before Easter 作主语。
engage 意为“使参加”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使参加让所有人都参加了搜寻”，should ever 之后用原形 engage everybody in the search。
engage 意为“使参加”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使参加让所有人都参加了搜寻（engage everybody in the search at once），以后再也不要提起。
engage 意为“聘用”，新来的病患每个夜晚都照例使参加让所有人都参加了搜寻，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 engages。
engage 意为“聘用”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人聘用复活节前聘了一位新看护，用一般过去式 engaged 叙述。
engage 意为“聘用”，结尾那句是母亲 1979 年的话：要聘用复活节前聘了一位新看护，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和病房记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 engage 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1967 the nurse engaged a new nurse before Easter for the whole place, and nobody in the ward forgot it.
Even now the nurse engages a new nurse before Easter without a word of thanks whenever the ward asks.
Engaging a new nurse before Easter for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever engage everybody in the search without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sufferer from the next ward engages everybody in the search for the whole place every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother engaged a new nurse before Easter again, and the ward remembered that half.
